== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A [[Guild]] War is a large-scale conflict involving the various organized factions within [[The Empire|the Empire]]. Historically, these [[Guilds]] served to maintain imperial balance and settle disputes through institutional means rather than private armies. However, the absence of an Emperor caused their shared dedication to [[The Empire|the Empire]] to fray, leading to intense internal strife. The conflict escalated from minor sabotages and border reinforcements into a full-scale war that pushed the capital to its limits. This warfare resulted in significant consequences, including the weakening of defenses around [[Great Elder tombs|Elder tombs]] and a breakdown in the cooperation required to secure the [[Great Elders]]. The war eventually reached an end when the remaining [[Regents]] declared it over following the discovery of criminal activities by the [[Imperial Steward]]. In the aftermath, regional governors began attempting to establish their own independent versions of the various [[Guilds]].}}
